description: This Java class 'HttpRequestTemplateObject' models an HTTP request template, encapsulating request details such as method, path, headers, cookies, body, security, and connection parameters. It extends 'RequestDefinition' and provides methods for accessing request properties, equality checks, and cloning.

classes.name: HttpRequestTemplateObject
